title: 3. What the action gate lets through
description: Five orders with different support. Try this: submit each one in the Orders tab and read the gate's reason. d_po_auto has two independent trusted origins and proceeds on its own; d_po_copies rests on two copies of one claim (same origin), which count once; d_po_vendor rests only on the vendor's own word; d_po_big is over the $5,000 limit; d_po_final cannot be undone. Then preview quarantining s_registry: its mirror goes too (same origin), and b_cert survives through the audit.

beliefs.claim: The supplier is certified (registry and its mirror)
The vendor says it is certified
